points.description: Names and describes two valid challenges of mobile/wireless routing compared to fixed wired networks (e.g. adaptation to topology changes/node mobility, security, medium access control such as hidden/exposed/near-far terminals, QoS, scalability, heterogeneity, dependability, power consumption). Each challenge must be named and given a correct brief description; equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.5) if only one valid challenge is named and described, or if two valid challenges are named but only one (or neither) is described adequately.
